latest_upstream_suite.command: for each tests/run/*.bend: bun fork/general_cli.ts file out.c; clang -std=gnu11 -O1 -ffp-contract=off out.c -lpthread -lm; run out +RTS --gpu off --threads 1 -RTS; compare stdout+stderr and exit status to #| directives
latest_upstream_suite.note: All 94 latest fixtures that compile to native executables match their expected output. The 10 compile-rejected entries are negative checker/compiler-diagnostic fixtures. The 8 GPU-marked fixtures were executed by the canonical Vulkan gate. Runtime flags are passed as +RTS ... -RTS so IO.args sees only the executable and user arguments.
